name: Webhooks
summary: External systems call an HTTP endpoint when something happens (a payment, a GitHub event, a form submission), and that call wakes the agent with the event as input. The agent reacts only to real events, so there is no polling cost.
how: Expose an HTTPS endpoint for the agent
Register it with the source system (GitHub, Stripe, etc.)
Verify the signature on each incoming request
Map the event to a prompt or a session and run the agent
Return quickly and process long work in the background
facts: Real-time and cheap at idle, but needs a public endpoint and per-source setup
goodFor: Reacting to events in other systems
watchOut: Endpoint must be public and authenticated
Senders retry, so handlers must be idempotent
